LAND AS SOON AS POSSIBLE definition
questions.answer: Land without delay at the nearest suitable area (i.e. open field) at which safe approach and landing is reasonably assured
acceptedAnswers: Land without delay at the nearest suitable area
Land without delay at the nearest suitable area (i.e. open field) at which safe approach and landing is reasonably assured

questions.question: LAND AS SOON AS PRACTICAL definition
questions.answer: The duration of the flight and landing site are at the discretion of the pilot. Extended flight beyond the nearest approved landing area is not recommended
acceptedAnswers: The duration of the flight and landing site are at the discretion of the pilot
The duration of the flight and landing site are at the discretion of the pilot. Extended flight beyond the nearest approved landing area is not recommended

questions.question: List 4 primary indications
questions.answer: ENG 1 OUT or ENG 2 OUT W/L ILLUMINATE; N1 drop below 53% and decreasing; N2 drop below 85% and decreasing; ITT drop below 400°C and decreasing
acceptedAnswers: ENG 1 OUT, N1 drop below 53%, N2 drop below 85%, ITT drop below 400°C
ENG OUT, N1 below 53%, N2 below 85%, ITT below 400C

questions.question: FLY THE A/C immediate actions (steps a, b, c)
questions.answer: a. Reduce power | b. Set airspeed 70 kts | c. Set N2 100% if possible
acceptedAnswers: Reduce power, Set airspeed 70 kts, Set N2 100%

questions.question: IDENTIFY & Engine shutdown steps (steps d, e, f, g)
questions.answer: d. IDLE STOP RELEASE to affected Eng | e. THROTTLE - CLOSED | f. BOOST PUMP - OFF | g. FUEL SWITCH - OFF
acceptedAnswers: IDLE STOP RELEASE, THROTTLE CLOSED, BOOST PUMP OFF, FUEL SWITCH OFF

questions.question: AUTOROTATION immediate actions (steps a, b, c, d)
questions.answer: a. Collective FULL DOWN | b. THROTTLE - CLOSE | c. Set airspeed 65 - 90 kts | d. ROTOR RPM - ON THE GREEN
acceptedAnswers: Collective FULL DOWN, THROTTLE CLOSE, airspeed 65-90 kts, ROTOR RPM ON THE GREEN

questions.question: Altimeter reading actions (e. 300 FT AGL, f. 100 FT AGL)
questions.answer: e. 300 FT AGL - OPEN THROTTLE | f. 100 FT AGL - FLARE
acceptedAnswers: 300 FT AGL OPEN THROTTLE, 100 FT AGL FLARE

questions.question: Engine Fire in Flight: Immediate initial actions (steps a, b)
questions.answer: a. FIRE PULL handle (affected Eng) - PULL | b. FIRE EXT - MAIN
acceptedAnswers: FIRE PULL handle PULL, FIRE EXT MAIN
FIRE PULL PULL, FIRE EXT MAIN

questions.question: Engine Fire in Flight: If 10 second FIRE PULL W/L remains ON
RIGHT PEDAL LOCKED FORWARD OR NEUTRAL: Approach & Touchdown technique
questions.answer: Shallow to normal approach; 2 to 5 ft AGL - Slowly reduce THROTTLE (luruskan heading); RUN ON LANDING
acceptedAnswers: Shallow to normal approach, 2 to 5 ft reduce throttle, RUN ON LANDING

questions.question: LEFT PEDAL LOCKED FORWARD: Approach & Touchdown technique
questions.answer: Normal to steep approach; 2 ft AGL - Apply COLLECTIVE as necessary (luruskan heading); ZERO SPEED TOUCHDOWN
acceptedAnswers: Normal to steep approach, 2 ft apply collective, ZERO SPEED TOUCHDOWN

questions.question: HYDRAULIC SYSTEM FAILURE: Procedure steps (e, f, g, h)
questions.answer: e. Affected system - IDENTIFY POSITIVELY | f. HYD SYS switch - OFF (affected system) | g. Set N2 100% | h. MASTER CAUTION - RESET | LAND AS SOON AS POSSIBLE
acceptedAnswers: IDENTIFY POSITIVELY, HYD SYS switch OFF, Set N2 100%, MASTER CAUTION RESET
